hypothesis: I021 failed because it changed only the finite incoming straight carriers while holding the connected curved-pipe base beam at Euler-Bernoulli. The B-3.2 bend package already qualifies the bend flexibility correction under a Timoshenko frame profile and proves the correction remains exact under its double-count guard. A coherent bend-family candidate should therefore apply the accepted base-beam shear law to non-tee BEND_INCOMING_STRAIGHT carriers and to the BEND_ARC component base frames together, while leaving the independently owned bend flexibility factor, pressure-stiffening factor authority, subdivision, tee mechanics and reducer mechanics unchanged.

harnessHistory.cause: The I015 guard used a global source.includes('0.01') prohibition intended for an old diagnostic grouping threshold, but the frozen production solver legitimately contains bendLengthErrorLimit=0.01. The failed artifact proves the exact accepted I015 candidate SHA bdf4c0e... was materialized. The guard was narrowed to require exactly the legitimate bendLengthErrorLimit occurrence and reject any additional 0.01 occurrence; candidate mechanics were not changed.

decisionReason: Corrected exact-head run 31317827038 completed the full locked Windows parent/candidate A/B with B3.1/B3.2/B3.3/B3.4 qualification, 12/12 bend coverage, 226 BEND_ARC carriers, 11 non-tee incoming-straight carriers, source-36 tee hold, identical reference custody, and target equilibrium at numerical roundoff. The coherent bend-family cutover improves L19 node 20090 FY from 8.542% to 4.463%, displacement/rotation failures 66 -> 65 with RMSnorm 0.34639 -> 0.31038, and source-action failures 23 -> 22 with RMSnorm 0.05304 -> 0.05245. However it still creates a new L19 restraint failure at node 20390 FZ, worsening the accepted-I015 9.961% error to 10.724%; the I019 9-11 MZ sentinel remains slightly improved while a new source-44 MZ threshold crossing appears on the bend-side I020 boundary. L20 materially regresses: restraints 6 -> 8, restraint RMSnorm 0.03825 -> 0.04161, source-end-action failures 134 -> 175 with RMSnorm 0.14976 -> 0.16579, and displacement/rotation RMSnorm 0.25686 -> 0.27539. Therefore the current model 'Timoshenko base beam + unchanged existing bend flexibility/pressure-stiffening ownership' is not accepted as the CAESAR-compatible bend architecture. The component-level B32-T23 proof remains valid, but system evidence shows additional bend-specific authority or formulation differences must be resolved before promotion. No production bend cutover is authorized.
